requirements.obligation: Separate documentary validity, operational acceptance and fit/data/release authority
requirements.required_evidence: Scope-specific dated principal decision and manifest; never inferred from tests

requirements.obligation: Trusted registrar binds current process handle, boot, generation, command and installed build; no caller self-registration
requirements.required_evidence: Operator-approved build record and registrar plus independent current-process observations

requirements.obligation: Durably reserve unique reservation/command before dispatch; journal crash uncertainty as consumed; never auto-resume
requirements.required_evidence: Transactional reserve receipt and crash/restart/replay tests

requirements.obligation: Authenticate scoped control intents and receipts; reject replay, revocation and wrong principal
requirements.required_evidence: Selected authenticated transport/proof verifier and negative authenticity tests

requirements.obligation: Recheck full binding under trusted consumer lock/owned handle immediately before one native break per command
requirements.required_evidence: Current-generation consumption evidence and concurrent/late/duplicate tests

requirements.obligation: Bound execution and cleanup with boot-scoped monotonic domains; reject rollback, nonfinite and unbounded cross-domain time
requirements.required_evidence: Approved numeric budgets and boundary/domain tests; no hidden grace

requirements.obligation: Arm independent supervisor before work; detect controller death without engine/event-loop cooperation
requirements.required_evidence: Supervisor identity/arm receipt and blocked-transport/controller-death tests

requirements.obligation: Verify authenticated ordered delivery, engine exit and cleanup separately; acknowledgement and registry absence are insufficient
requirements.required_evidence: Verified event chain plus independent exact-process exit and cleanup observations

requirements.obligation: Quarantine all uncertain states and replacements; preserve consumed attempts and late outputs; no retry or relabel
requirements.required_evidence: Forward-only journal/recovery records and late-result/replacement tests

requirements.obligation: Restrict journal to approved control metadata; protect secrets and participant content; preserve failure packets
requirements.required_evidence: Allowlist/redaction test using artificial canaries and restricted preservation manifest

requirements.obligation: Bound cleanup and separately authorize exact owned-process fallback; no process-name/default-session kill
requirements.required_evidence: Owned-handle/fallback decision and exact exit/cleanup receipts; unknown remains quarantined

requirements.obligation: Stage adoption only after implementation decisions, independent acceptance and exact new authority; never activate a fit automatically
requirements.required_evidence: Signed scope/build/test matrix plus preserved dispositions and separate later fit contract

open_choices.subject: Durable journal backend, atomicity/durability and crash semantics
Authenticated transport, canonical proof format, principal/key provisioning and revocation
Independent supervisor hosting, failure detection, owned handles and fallback isolation
Trusted registration/build attestation and approved installation/change procedure
Exact execution/cleanup budgets, clock-domain proof and transport-delay bounds
Acceptance principal, disposable/empty-engine scope and separately scoped service/fallback changes
Restricted journal/receipt location, allowlist, retention and disclosure review
